notes: All prior exact-graph findings are repaired: typed adapter scope and information flow; substantive provider routes; stochastic zero-noise headline qualification; and consistent exclusion of the unused appendix J<=0 cubic tuning while retaining the main raw rate for every sign of J.

The source, environment, policy fingerprint, repository basis and source proof nodes are unchanged from independently inspected snapshots. New differences are the repaired internal object scopes and tuned selector contracts; they were inspected directly on this basis.

The user-approved4.8 departure is only a supplied global one-sided upper bound on the Hessian quadratic form in the Muon direction. Original arbitrary-horizon raw and positive-J conditional source statements remain supporting obligations; the public result must be identified as the strengthened-assumption corollary.

Positive supplied bounds do not require positive actual gap or actual smoothness. The source stochastic criterion is expected unsquared nuclear gradient norm; the4.8 criterion is pointwise nuclear norm at the best queried exact-gradient point.
